title: [UX] Sync active worktree and complete node-build / row-roulette UX
body:
﻿## Goal
Make the local `omenward` path the GitHub-tracking active canonical worktree, then implement the remaining approved in-game UX: node-selected building installation and central-row roulette resolution.

## Background
The user-facing local path currently pointed to a dirty `main` worktree at `9f79fca`, while GitHub and the current canonical vertical slice are on `codex/issue-41-base-pr18-refresh` at `486f80d`. The mismatch prevented local play from reflecting pushed work.

## Scope
- Preserve the dirty legacy `omenward` worktree as recoverable `pre-cutover`; do not discard its art/config files.
- Recreate the normal `omenward` path as a branch that tracks the canonical GitHub branch.
- Record the active local path, branch, commit, remote, and pull/push verification.
- Implement click/select for friendly construction nodes, a contextual building-list panel, and selected-node installation using the existing building service without a permanent bottom build menu.
- Evaluate roulette by the approved contract: the center horizontal row must be one non-X symbol; only then count all eight horizontal/vertical/diagonal completed lines for that same symbol to determine rank.
- Complete the tactical-skill, shop, and Bellu UX surfaces to the extent backed by existing systems; explicitly disable/label unsupported actions rather than faking effects.

## Exclusions
- No deletion or overwrite of preserved legacy user changes.
- No new unit archetypes, economy tuning, stage content, or final art extraction from supplied reference sheets.

## Acceptance
- Opening `C:\Users\user\Documents\?????\omenward-base-full-11-migration\omenward\project.godot` runs the branch tracking GitHub's active canonical work.
- A player can select an available friendly node, view permitted buildings, choose one, and see installation feedback; invalid/occupied/locked nodes are explained.
- Roulette visibly highlights the center evaluation row, rejects rewards on a center-row miss, and reports completed-line count/rank using the fixed matching symbol.
- Automated contracts cover sync metadata, node selection/install flow, and row evaluation; Godot headless suite/runtime smoke remain green.
- 1920?1080 and 1280?720 human play QA remains `[???]` until performed.
